rawContent: @MichaelJStern1 @JoeBiden @USATODAY Michael Stern has experience as a prosecutor. Pls read his article & follow his logic. I am a woman & my 1st reaction to Ms. Reade’s  allegation was “This doesn’t feel right”. Too many women have tarnished the #Metoo right by using it to lie for revenge & admitting to it. 😢

@NancyLeeGrahn @MichaelJStern1 @joncoopertweets @JoeBiden @USATODAY Thank you Nancy! I completely agree. I am a woman & have my own stories. Books have been written, articles published, etc about the abusive side of the #Metoo right. Is it human nature? Revenge get the best of us? Sadly it is the downside but it forces us question as we should.

@MichaelJStern1 @NancyLeeGrahn @joncoopertweets @JoeBiden @USATODAY All perspectives should be considered when facing ruining a persons life. Too many women & men have lied for revenge sake.  All people of abuse should be heard ..all of them. But we must have the ability to vet them thoroughly & filter out those who lie & tarnish #Metoo rights.
